scenes.name: title
scenes.draws: A title card that loads the shared theme; it only lays out and animates its text.
scenes.edit: the kicker, title, rule and sub text; the palette comes from theme/theme.css

scenes.name: bar
scenes.draws: An animated vertical bar chart; the last bar is the accent, the rest are the color.
scenes.edit: the data array (label, value); or load a data.json in `ready`

scenes.name: line
scenes.draws: An animated line chart that grows left to right, with the last point as the accent.
scenes.edit: the data array (label, value); or load a data.json in `ready`

scenes.name: pie
scenes.draws: A donut chart that sweeps in, with labels and a percentage in the middle.
scenes.edit: the data array (label, value); the parts are normalized to 100%

scenes.name: kpi
scenes.draws: A 2x2 grid of key numbers, each counting up with a green or red delta.
scenes.edit: the values, labels and deltas (each with a direction)

scenes.name: progress
scenes.draws: Progress bars that fill left to right with a percentage that rises to 100%.
scenes.edit: the labels and the target percentages

scenes.name: screenshot
scenes.draws: A screen scene: a background (a real screenshot via --bg-image, or the built-in app mock) with a cursor, clicks, highlights and typed text over it.
scenes.edit: the events (move, click, highlight, type) with normalized 0-1 coordinates; or drop a real screenshot in --bg-image

scenes.name: terminal
scenes.draws: A terminal that types a scripted sequence of commands and shows their output, with a blinking cursor.
